5-Amino-1MQ: A small-molecule inhibitor of nicotinamide N-methyltransferase (NNMT), used in research on cellular energy metabolism and NAD+ salvage pathways.
ACE-031: An engineered fusion protein built from the activin receptor type IIB (ActRIIB) ligand-binding domain, examined in research on the myostatin pathway and skeletal-muscle tissue.
AHK-Cu: A copper-binding tripeptide made of alanine, histidine and lysine, investigated alongside GHK-Cu in skin and tissue-regeneration research.
AOD-9604: A modified hGH 176-191 fragment, the C-terminal portion of human growth hormone, investigated in lipid-metabolism research.
Adamax: An adamantane-modified analog of Semax, investigated in nootropic and neurotrophic research.
Ara-290: A short peptide derived from erythropoietin that does not stimulate red-cell production, investigated in neuroprotection and inflammation research.
BPC-157: A synthetic 15-amino-acid peptide and one of the most widely cited compounds in tissue-repair and recovery research.
BPC-157 + GHK-Cu + TB-500 + KPV Blend (K: A four-peptide blend of BPC-157, GHK-Cu, TB-500 and KPV in a single vial, prepared for research protocols that study tissue-repair pathways together.
BPC-157 + GHK-Cu + TB-500 Blend (Glow): A three-peptide blend of BPC-157, GHK-Cu and TB-500 in a single vial, prepared for combined tissue-repair and recovery research.
BPC-157 + TB-500 Blend: BPC-157 and TB-500 together in one vial, the pairing most often cited in regenerative research literature.
Bacteriostatic Water: Sterile water with 0.9% benzyl alcohol for laboratory use.
CJC-1295 with DAC: A GHRH analog carrying a Drug Affinity Complex (DAC) that extends its half-life, investigated in growth-hormone secretion research.
CJC-1295 without DAC: A GHRH analog investigated in growth-hormone secretion research, usually studied together with a GHRP.
CJC-1295 without DAC + Ipamorelin: A GHRH analog paired with a selective GHRP in one vial, among the most frequently cited combinations in growth-hormone-axis research.
Cagrilintide: A long-acting analog of amylin, investigated in metabolic and appetite-regulation research and often studied alongside GLP-1 agonists.
Cagrilintide + Semaglutide: An amylin analog and a GLP-1 receptor agonist combined in one vial for metabolic research.
DSIP: Delta sleep-inducing peptide, a naturally occurring neuropeptide investigated in sleep-regulation and stress-response research.
Epithalon: A synthetic four-amino-acid peptide (Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly) that grew out of pineal-gland peptide research and is investigated for telomerase activity and cellular aging.
FOXO4-DRI: A peptide engineered to interfere with the FOXO4-p53 interaction, investigated in cellular-senescence research.
GHK-Cu: A naturally occurring copper-binding tripeptide with a large body of research on skin regeneration, wound healing and collagen synthesis.
GHRP-2 Acetate: A growth-hormone-releasing peptide that acts on the ghrelin receptor, investigated in growth-hormone secretion research.
GHRP-6 Acetate: A six-amino-acid growth-hormone secretagogue investigated in growth-hormone-axis and appetite research.
Glutathione: Glutathione (GSH) is the body's own tripeptide antioxidant. It reduces peroxides, maintains cellular redox balance, protects protein thiols and drives glutathione-transferase conjugation, and is used in oxidative-stress, mitochondrial-defense, liver-detoxification, redox-signaling and pharmacokinetic research.
HGH Frag 176-191: The fragment of human growth hormone spanning amino acids 176 to 191, investigated in lipolysis research.
IGF-1 LR3: A long-acting analog of insulin-like growth factor 1, investigated in cell-growth and muscle-tissue research.
Ipamorelin: A selective growth-hormone secretagogue that mimics ghrelin and, in published research, shows little effect on cortisol or prolactin.
KPV: A three-amino-acid fragment of alpha-MSH investigated in inflammation research.
LL-37: The active fragment of human cathelicidin, investigated in antimicrobial-peptide and immune-response research.
L-Carnitine: L-carnitine supplied as a 600mg/ml, 50ml preparation for laboratory and analytical use.
Lemon Bottle: A blend used in research on lipolysis and the breakdown of fat cells.
Lipo-C: A lipotropic blend used in research on fat metabolism.
MOTS-c: A peptide encoded by mitochondrial DNA, investigated in metabolic and mitochondrial-function research.
Melanotan I: A synthetic analog of alpha-MSH investigated in melanocortin-receptor and pigmentation research.
Melanotan II: A synthetic analog of alpha-MSH investigated in melanocortin-receptor research, covering both pigmentation and appetite pathways.
NA-Selank Amidate: N-acetyl Selank amidate, a form of Selank modified at both ends (acetylated and amidated), investigated in anxiolytic and nootropic research.
NAD+: Nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide, a central coenzyme in cellular energy production, investigated in metabolism and aging research.
PE 22-28: A shortened analog of spadin that blocks the TREK-1 potassium channel, investigated in mood and stress-response research.
PT-141: Bremelanotide, a melanocortin-receptor agonist investigated in neuroendocrine research.
Pinealon: A synthetic three-amino-acid bioregulator from the pineal-peptide research line, investigated in neuroprotection and cognition research.
Retatrutide: A single molecule that activates the GLP-1, GIP and glucagon receptors, investigated in next-generation metabolic and incretin research.
RU58841: An investigational nonsteroidal androgen-receptor antagonist supplied as a 5% solution for controlled laboratory work on androgen-receptor binding. For research use only; not for human or veterinary use.
SS-31: A four-amino-acid peptide that targets the inner mitochondrial membrane, investigated in oxidative-stress and mitochondrial-function research.
Selank: A synthetic seven-amino-acid analog of tuftsin, investigated in anxiolytic and stress-response research.
Semaglutide: A GLP-1 receptor agonist and one of the most extensively studied compounds in metabolic and incretin research.
Semax: A synthetic analog of ACTH(4-10), investigated in neurotrophic and cognitive research.
Semax 10mg + Selank 10mg: Semax and Selank, two heptapeptides studied in cognitive and stress-response research, combined in one preparation.
Semax 5mg + Selank 5mg: Semax and Selank, two heptapeptides studied in cognitive and stress-response research, combined in one preparation at the lower strength.
Sermorelin: An analog of the first 29 amino acids of GHRH, investigated in growth-hormone secretion research.
Snap-8: A synthetic octapeptide investigated for its effect on neuromuscular signaling in cosmetic research.
TB-500: A synthetic fragment of Thymosin Beta-4, investigated in tissue-repair and cell-migration research.
Tesamorelin: A synthetic GHRH analog investigated in growth-hormone secretion and lipodystrophy research.
Thymalin: A peptide complex derived from the thymus, investigated in immune-modulation research.
Thymosin Alpha-1: A 28-amino-acid peptide first isolated from the thymus, investigated in immune-response research.
Tirzepatide: A single molecule that activates both the GIP and GLP-1 receptors, investigated in next-generation metabolic and incretin research.
